name: Adam Smith
shortBio: Scottish Enlightenment moral philosopher and political economist whose landmark treatises unified moral sentiment with decentralized commercial society.
centralQuestion: How do innate sympathy and decentralized self-interest produce moral harmony and social flourishing?

keyWorks.title: The Theory of Moral Sentiments
keyWorks.description: Foundational moral philosophy treatise arguing that ethical judgment arises from mutual sympathy and the internal guidance of the impartial spectator.

keyWorks.title: The Wealth of Nations
keyWorks.description: Groundbreaking treatise of classical economics analyzing the division of labor, productivity, market mechanisms, and the invisible hand.

keyWorks.title: Essays on Philosophical Subjects
keyWorks.description: Posthumously collected essays containing his pioneering psychological and historical study of the principles that lead and direct philosophical inquiries.
